page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block from top to bottom, then a woodcut monogram with the place name beneath it, then the imprint lines at the foot. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible and is not transcribed. Handwritten "4" at top right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: V. D. M. in Illustrissimo Bernatum Athenæo
Ad diem 19. Augusti, horâ locoq; solitè.
Ex Officina Typogr. Illustris. Reip. Bernensis.

page.notes: Woodcut monogram (interlaced initials in a wreath) between the date line and "BERNÆ," is an engraving and is not transcribed. The pen-style "A-6'087'820" at the lower right and the library stamp "Universitätsbibliothek Bern" are not part of the printed page and are omitted. The "V. D. M." and "Helv. Bernas." abbreviations are kept as printed. The "Quam" line is set in a larger italic with a swash Q.
